payload.body: WP05 amendment from hv's answer to question 4 (vc, 2026-10-31): pre-flight probes every declared leg host (ssh -o BatchMode=yes with a short connect timeout, a true); a host it cannot reach is named at pre-flight, early, and that leg is `absent` in the plan the confirm shows; the cut goes on without it and the RELEASE seal records the leg as not run and why (D62 amended). A host that was reached and whose leg then fails is `failed` and stops the cut as any leg does. An absent machine never holds a release up: gyges is used when it is there, kovacs is a VM hv starts. The leg_read word for an unreached host at probe time is `absent`, a sixth word the loop treats as "not a leg this cut has", distinct from `unknown` (reached, then could not read). Build it when the hold lifts; WP05 stays banked unrun meanwhile.
